why: A copy of the source a run executed, kept as evidence, is stored as lossless gzip (ADR-0367's archive rule): under its executable extension the repository's Python analyzers read it as project code, and Ruff's new-only gate failed #126 on it. Its decoded bytes are the original's: each raw_sha256 is the one SHA256SUMS lists. The frozen scripts here name the original path; decode it first (`gzip -dc X.py.gz > X.py`) to run one again.
